$Comment: Defense XP added to what clearing the Turkey Graveyard's hard way in pays (the
rolls for each member present at a hard clear), on a server running MMO Skill Tree: the hard twin of
ContributesTo folds this roll into that table without touching its file, so the table's own pay is
tuned there alone. Requires takes this file out on a server without MMO Skill Tree, so the table pays
exactly what its own file says there; always write it with Min 1. A roll with no Chance always pays,
and Amount is XP before any boost. The dungeon pays the table in full on the first hard clear each day
and half on later ones, and that halving reaches this roll too.
Name: Mmo_Harvest_Feast_Turkey_Graveyard_Clear_Hard
